title: Large Bayesian Tensor Autoregressions
abstract: arXiv:2511.03097v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The availability of multidimensional economic datasets has grown significantly in recent years. An example is bilateral trade values across goods among countries, comprising three dimensions -- importing countries, exporting countries, and goods -- forming a third-order tensor time series. This paper introduces a general Bayesian tensor autoregressive framework to analyze the dynamics of large, multidimensional time series with a particular focus on international trade across different countries and sectors. Departing from the standard homoscedastic assumption in this literature, we incorporate flexible stochastic volatility into the tensor autoregressive models. The proposed models can capture time-varying volatility due to the COVID-19 pandemic and recent outbreaks of war. To address computational challenges and mitigate overfitting, we develop an efficient sampling method based on low-rank Tucker decomposition and hierarchical shr

translated_title: 大型贝叶斯张量自回归模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：近年来，多维经济数据集的可用性显著增长。一个例子是各国间按商品分类的双边贸易值，包含三个维度——进口国、出口国和商品——形成一个三阶张量时间序列。本文引入一个通用的贝叶斯张量自回归框架，用于分析大型多维时间序列的动态，特别关注不同国家和部门之间的国际贸易。与文献中标准的同方差假设不同，我们将灵活随机波动性纳入张量自回归模型中。所提出的模型能够捕捉由于COVID-19疫情和近期战争爆发引起的时变波动性。为解决计算挑战并减轻过拟合问题，我们开发了一种基于低秩Tucker分解和分层收缩的高效采样方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合随机波动性和低秩Tucker分解的贝叶斯张量自回归框架，用于高效分析大型多维时间序列（如国际贸易数据）的动态与时变波动性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian tensor autoregressive framework with stochastic volatility and low-rank Tucker decomposition to efficiently analyze dynamics and time-varying volatility in large multidimensional time series, such as international trade data.
